question: My 2025 return asks for province of residence. I was still living in Manitoba on December 31, then moved to Ontario in January. The software filled in Ontario from my current mailing address. Which province should this field show?
generated_answer: You must enter the province you resided in on December 31, 2025. This is the province you will use to complete the T1 return. To change the province, click the province name on the main return tab. This will open a window in which you can change the province. Once you have selected the correct province, click OK to save your changes. The province of residence is used to determine which tax laws apply to your return. If you are a resident of Manitoba, you will use the Manitoba tax laws to complete your return. If you are a resident of Ontario, you will use the Ontario tax laws to complete your return. If you are a resident of both provinces, you will use the tax laws of the province in which you resided on December 31, 2025.
